newsitem.title: CHINA: China forex market turnover slightly down in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China forex market turnover slightly down in 1996.

text.p: The China Foreign Exchange Trade System, a national interbank market based in Shanghai, traded $62.84 billion equivalent in 1996, slightly down from $65.5 billion in 1995, the Shanghai Securities News said on Saturday.

Average daily turnover on the market, which trades the U.S. dollar, Hong Kong dollar and Japanese yen against the Chinese yuan, was $246 million in 1996 against $260 million in 1995, the newspaper said.

The breakdown in 1996 was $58.19 billion against $59.5 billion in 1995, HK$28.55 billion against HK$43.2 billion and Japanese yen 89.13 billion against 49.3 billion, the newspaper said. The yen began trading on the exchange in March 1995.
The Chinese yuan at the end of 1996 was 8.2984 to the U.S. dollar, up from 8.3174 at the end of 1995.
